name: Lewis Carroll
source:
A priest from a religious organization and self-proclaimed “Shining White Knight.” He is an imposter of Lewis Carroll. While he claims to be a knight, he is actually a terrible man who has no regard for policy and doesn’t carry a sword, instead beating or shooting people to death. According to himself, he is satisfied with the current position he’s in. Although he seems like some sort of government official, no matter how you attempt to interpret it you’d be absolutely wrong.

[Taken from [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/otomegames/comments/ht6694/spade_no_kuni_no_alice_character_profiles/fyfl282/]Reddit[/url]]
